# Transporeon: Rate Management 2 API

- **Product:** Transporeon: Rate Management 2 API (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP basic. Declared security schemes: basicAuth.
- **Access:** Transporeon Rate Management customers.
- **To call it you would need:** Transporeon credentials for api.transporeon.com/ratemanagement2.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.test.transporeon.com/ratemanagement2`, `https://api.transporeon.com/ratemanagement2`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/transporeon-ratemanagement2-v1-swagger-json](https://api.transporeon.com/ratemanagement2/v1/swagger.json) (Rate Management 2, version 1.0.1). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230373/API+for+Rate+Management+2.
